key_insight: Direct interpolation followed by constraint optimization remaps ALE hydrodynamic fields with minimal diffusion while enforcing physical bounds and global conservation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports high-order finite element simulations with large Lagrangian mesh displacements while preserving sharp features and conserving volume, mass, momentum, and total energy.
method: Transfer fields through GPU-capable physical-space interpolation instead of pseudo-transient PDE advection.
Restore global conservation through optimization while preserving physical bounds.
Remap arbitrary-order finite element fields and integration-point quantities directly.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on standard two- and three-dimensional remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations; the abstract provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: The computational cost and parallel scalability of the conservation-restoring optimization require assessment for large simulations.
paper_title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
